Since the quality of the optimized parameter is dependent on the algorithm, evaluation on various algorithms can be necessary but will require substantial computational resources. Therefore, appropriate parameters and algorithms have to be selected in order to derive a good quality solution within a reasonable amount of time. Such selection is difficult because it would require knowledge of the task to be realized. In this paper, the concept of hyperheuristic is utilized.
